heart_voice_caption#2.Text:
真稀奇。
我有安排了

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_001

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_002
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: Timoris。我，毋畏恐惧

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_003
heart_voice_caption#2.Text:

heart_voice_caption#2.Text:

heart_voice_caption#2.Name: voice_007
heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 请多多关照

heart_voice_caption#2.Text: 我喜欢检查音响器材
